message.reasoning:
I'm settling on the framework: the regions include Switzerland and Germany, with ABB being Swiss and lacking text sources. Only market cap, 20-day dollar volume, and 12-month price return cover every region, while the SEC facts only apply to the US. I'm considering sub-themes around grid equipment automation, energy efficiency with demand response, and storage inverters, and I'm starting to define the first KPI, grid digital revenue share.

I'm working out the KPI set now: a grid automation revenue share, an efficiency and demand response offering, and a storage inverter revenue share, each with a weight. The investability metrics (market cap, 20-day dollar volume, 12-month return) would sit under their own sub-theme, and I'm leaning toward no hard gate, since text sources can't cover the Swiss and German names.

I'm setting the thresholds now: revenue shares in percent, market cap, dollar volume, and 12-month return on their own scales, plus a small R&D intensity proxy for the grid automation sub-theme. Lookbacks are 730 days for filings, 30 for market cap and volume, and 380 for returns. Pure fossil fuel names would simply score zero on the revenue-share KPIs, so I'll note that in the rationale rather than adding a separate exclusion.

I'm keeping the wording tight, so I'll trim the rest of the KPI write-up down to what matters.
